Card Q&A.q: Does this card's "when you would play this card" effect also activate when this card would be played by an effect?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. Even if the part after the conditions specified with "by X" in an effect can't be resolved, the effect can still activate.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to place 1 of my level 6 Digimon on top of my security stack even when I don't have [Lucemon: Chaos Mode] in my trash?
Can I use this card's [End of Your Turn] effect to place 1 of my level 6 Digimon on top of my security stack but choose to not digivolve this Digimon into [Lucemon: Chaos Mode] in my trash?

Card Q&A.a:
No, you can't. You can’t ignore the digivolution requirements.
